DOCKLINE weapon reference photographs

The following nine photographs provided the exterior references for new Tripo game props.
Photograph credits and rights statements apply to the cited original images.
The Trident reference shows an empty magazine well. Its animated magazine comes
from the new Breaker Tripo mesh; the rest of Trident uses its own FAMAS export.
Valve’s CS2 Workshop Style Guide informed the evaluation of materials in the game:
https://www.counter-strike.net/workshop/workshopstyleguide
